blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A China-linked hacking group sought to infiltrate Philippine government officials by sending malware disguised as confidential diplomatic documents ahead of the country’s hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, a cybersecurity research firm said.
